Same accuracy, different prediction loss

Standard conformal only · 24 November 2026

Findings

Every case has the same realized correctness pattern for every seed and split; mean joint top-1 accuracy is 80.04%. All comparisons use standard split conformal with the product score. No method or case was chosen using test results.

Vary confidence on wrong predictions: at 90% nominal coverage, mean set sizes span 31.86–113.07, covered information spans 0.16–2.21 bits, and mean absolute class coverage gaps span 2.48–2.63 percentage points.

Vary the true label probability on errors: at 90% nominal coverage, mean set sizes span 17.80–130.47, covered information spans 0.01–2.60 bits, and mean absolute class coverage gaps span 2.51–2.61 percentage points.

Concentrate larger loss in half the classes: at 90% nominal coverage, mean set sizes span 34.25–83.44, covered information spans 0.55–2.06 bits, and mean absolute class coverage gaps span 2.58–8.46 percentage points.

Vary confidence on wrong predictions: joint NLL changes from 1.64 to 2.81; the corresponding mean set sizes are 31.86 and 113.07. These are controlled changes in scores with identical labels and argmax predictions.

Vary the true label probability on errors: joint NLL changes from 1.43 to 3.71; the corresponding mean set sizes are 17.80 and 130.47. These are controlled changes in scores with identical labels and argmax predictions.

Concentrate larger loss in half the classes: joint NLL changes from 1.74 to 2.27; the corresponding mean set sizes are 34.25 and 83.44. These are controlled changes in scores with identical labels and argmax predictions.

Cross-entropy summarizes average true-label plausibility; it does not specify the whole score distribution or how loss is allocated across classes. Inspect the localized-loss block and class-coverage heatmap before treating loss as a complete predictor of efficiency or class coverage.

A descriptive near-matched-loss contrast: Error confidence 0.9 and Hard-cohort confidence 0.97 have NLL 2.261 and 2.268 (within 1%), yet class gaps 2.53 and 8.46 pp. This pair was found from the sweep after evaluation and is exploratory, not a prespecified statistical test.

Smaller sets are useful only together with coverage. Covered information assigns zero to empty sets and to sets missing the truth, so an aggressive rule cannot appear informative merely by returning empty or incorrect singleton sets.

Design and metrics

Labels and argmax predictions must match exactly across every case, block, split and seed. Change cross-entropy through error confidence, probability assigned to the true label on errors, or class-localized error confidence.

One YAML defines this entire group: shared base settings, blocks, their fixed settings, and all cases. There are 17 cases, 5 seeds (42, 43, 44, 45, 46), 30,000 examples per seed, 132 joint labels, and alpha levels 0.05, 0.1, 0.15, 0.2, 0.25. Comparisons are paired by seed; whiskers are seed ranges; tables show mean ± sample SD. Neither is a confidence interval.

Efficiency is mean joint prediction-set size (lower is better at comparable coverage). Information per nonempty set is log2(number of candidates / set size); empty sets receive zero. Mean covered information also assigns zero when the true joint label is missing. This measures combinatorial candidate reduction under a uniform candidate reference, not posterior entropy or calibrated uncertainty. Singleton, correct-singleton, empty, full-set and nonempty non-full-set rates are exported at every alpha.

Class coverage gap averages abs(per-class coverage − nominal coverage) across classes. Undercoverage gaps and worst-class coverage are exported as well. Standard conformal guarantees joint marginal coverage under exchangeability, not within every class.

Interpretation and limits

These are synthetic experiments with 5 seeds. Ranges and SDs are descriptive; no significance test or universal monotonic relationship is claimed.

Expected top-1 accuracy is 80%. Shared correctness across heads is kept fixed. The 80% coverage target lies near the mixture boundary between correct and wrong score components, so thresholds and set sizes can be sensitive to seed there.

Study the group-specific control alongside the main contrasts. Population overall coverage can remain close to nominal while some classes are undercovered. Per-class estimates still contain finite-test noise; observed-class gaps omit unobserved classes.

Sources

Exact source run paths and hashes are in source_runs.csv. Control checks are in controls.json; case definitions and original settings are pinned in study.json. Raw and aggregated comparisons are in comparison.csv and summary.csv; paired differences are within each block against its declared reference.

To rebuild without new simulations, run the same study command with --manifest pointing to this report directory's study.json.
